'''Rosewood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]]<ref name="CCW" /> that shared its name with the type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]] known as [[Rose (flower)/Legends|rose]].<ref name="Lords">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ecologist/Legends|ecologist]] and [[Force Adept]] [[Ish'tay]], who resided on the [[Caamas Firestorm|devastated]]<ref name="CCW" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], possessed a gnarled [[Staff/Legends|staff]] made of rosewood. Having at one point studied the [[Alien jungle|jungle]] that had become the first area of [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] growing on the otherwise barren world, Ish'tay used the staff to lean on.<ref name="CCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rosewood was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CCW" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Rosewood|rosewood]] is an ornamental brown&ndash;to&ndash;purple-brown timber produced from several different tropical trees.<ref name="Rosewood Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/plant/rosewood-tree-and-timber|text=Rosewood &#124; Exotic Hardwood, Durable Timber & Fragrant Oil|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2025-01-25|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20241207185628}}</ref>
